limitations: Single candidate run and engineering review only; not independent clinician validation.
Main text, uncertainty and generation metadata are assessed together; supported fields do not excuse contradictory fields.
The two prompt experiments also include retrieval/provenance fixes, so end-to-end changes cannot all be causally assigned to prompt alone.
No raw rejected provider response was reconstructed; final run had no rejected generation route.
Supported does not mean ideal style: broad wording, technical jargon, redundant context and B12 timeframe placement still merit UX improvement.
